title: Hide Something: photos, videos
summary: The most popular, fast and easy HIDE app!
description:
📱 Your Personal Privacy Guardian - The Most-Loved Media Vault! ✨
🔐 NEW & AMAZING: Browse your secret photos & videos on your computer with just one tap!
Keep your precious memories and videos safe and sound! Our super-friendly app lets you hide any media in a snap - and yes, it's totally FREE! 🎉
Why Choose Us? 🌟

Share your phone freely without worry - your hidden treasures stay secret! 🤫
Create custom collections for different friends and family 🎯
Show off your gallery with confidence, knowing private media is safely tucked away 🔒

✨ Awesome Features That'll Make You Smile:

Unlock with style - choose from fingerprint magic 👆, pattern drawing ⭐, or trusty PIN code
Hide photos & videos instantly from any app with our quick-share magic wand 🪄
View your secret gallery on your computer - how cool is that! 💻
Keep everything extra safe with Google Drive backup ☁️
Perfect for all your memories - selfies, family videos, GIFs, and more! 🎬
Crystal-clear media viewing for every detail ✨
Gorgeous themes to match your style 🎨
Sneaky 'fake mode' for ultimate privacy protection 🕵️‍♀️
Works beautifully on phones and tablets 📱

Easy as 1-2-3! 🎯

Pick the photos & videos you want to keep private
Set up your secret unlock pattern
Access your hidden collection anytime!

💝 From Our Heart to Yours:
"We created this app because we wanted something simple, beautiful, and reliable for keeping private media safe. We hope you'll love it as much as we do!" - Your Dev Team
Need Help? We're Here! 🤝
Having troubles? Questions? Ideas? Drop us a line at coliferlab@gmail.com - we're super friendly and love hearing from you! Let's make this app even better together!
📚 Help Center: http://bit.ly/pg_help

Let's keep your memories and moments safe and sound together! 🌈✨
recentChanges: Fingerprint unlock is back! 🔐 Long-press any folder to use “View on Computer” without opening it. Fixed an issue where some images couldn’t generate thumbnails or be viewed in your desktop browser. ✨ Update now for a smoother experience!
